title: Clerk feature card
description: A 16px-rounded feature tile: an illustration area plus a small 13px title and muted text, above or below it. White with a layered soft shadow on light themes; #212126 with a faint inner top highlight on dark ones.
notes: rows/cols spans apply from md up; put cards in a grid with fixed row heights (clerk-features does)
the card is a hover group: illustrations can animate with group-hover
